pushok.title: PushOk: a simpler start without Home Assistant
pushok.intro: We want to make your first sensor easier to connect: a small Zigbee hub, a phone app and GrowerHub. No separate computer or server setup. We are starting with PushOk owners willing to try the connection together with us.
pushok.availability: The PushOk integration with GrowerHub has not been implemented yet. We are collecting requests and will verify the connection method and compatibility with pilot participants.
pushok.path_title: The path we want to build

steps.title: Leave a request
steps.text: Tell us how to contact you and, if you know, your hub and sensor models. If you have no equipment yet, say so: that also helps us choose a suitable starter kit.

steps.title: Check the equipment together
steps.text: The starting point is a PushOk hub and one compatible air or soil sensor. The hub itself is set up in the Upravlyator phone app. Check the exact sensor model in the manufacturer’s compatibility list.

steps.title: Test the GrowerHub connection
steps.text: We will get in touch shortly and agree on a trial connection. Our goal is to avoid Home Assistant and an always-on computer. Exact steps will follow testing on a real hub.

steps.title: Start with readings
steps.text: Our first pilot goal is fresh readings from one sensor and a chart. Smart plug control and watering will be discussed separately, after equipment checks and with your agreement.

pushok.invitation: Already using PushOk? Help us make setup easier: tell us what you grow and what you would like to automate. A request does not connect your hub or change your devices. We do not ask for passwords or access keys.
pushok.purchase_note: If you do not own a hub yet, leave a request and try the demo farm first. It is too early to buy equipment specifically for this pilot. This is a GrowerHub initiative; we do not claim a partnership with the manufacturer.

early_access_text: The main functions of GrowerHub are already available for free and without a card. Connect equipment, assemble zones and customize controls at your own pace. If you need help, the GrowerHub team is nearby on Telegram.

start.title: How to get started with GrowerHub
start.description: How to start with GrowerHub: a demo farm without equipment, Zigbee2MQTT connections and the upcoming PushOk hub pilot.
start.intro: Explore a prepared farm or connect one of your own sensors first. You can start monitoring before adding every plant or configuring automation.

steps.title: Login
steps.text: Use Yandex or Google. No card needed.

steps.title: Select mode
steps.text: Choose whether Zigbee2MQTT is already running or this is a new setup with a USB coordinator.

steps.title: Create a connection
steps.text: Name the coordinator and save your personal configuration. For an existing Zigbee2MQTT installation, the wizard will prepare a local bridge.

steps.title: Run package
steps.text: Select Windows, Raspberry Pi/Linux, or download the configuration for manual installation.

steps.title: See devices
steps.text: GrowerHub automatically shows devices and the metrics exposed by Zigbee2MQTT.

steps.title: Create a zone
steps.text: Specify only the name and distribute the devices. Plants are added as desired.

steps.title: Open dashboard
steps.text: View data and manage permitted functions. Turn on automation later.

paths.title: I have PushOk or want a simple hub
paths.text: Join the pilot waiting list. The integration is not live yet: leave a request to discuss your first sensor.

paths.title: Try it without equipment
paths.text: Open a prepared demo farm with charts, watering and scenarios. No registration is required.

paths.title: Already using Home Assistant / Zigbee2MQTT
paths.text: Keep your Zigbee network and local MQTT. Add the connector and verify one sensor.

paths.title: Start with a USB coordinator on Windows
paths.text: Check the COM port and adapter type, download your personal configuration and start the package.

start.help: Tell us your coordinator model, Windows or Linux, whether you use Home Assistant and the step where you stopped. We can help get your first sensor reporting in the dashboard.

minimum.title: Minimum setup for Zigbee2MQTT
minimum.monitoring: Always-on computer or Raspberry Pi, supported Zigbee coordinator and one temperature/humidity sensor.
minimum.control: For control, add a Zigbee smart plug. Soil sensors, leak sensors and other equipment can be connected later.
minimum.existing: If Zigbee2MQTT and Home Assistant are already running, the local bridge will leave MQTT in place and transfer only the necessary topics to GrowerHub.
